summary: Quick regression test after brand logo update (text wordmark -> /crluys-logo.png image). All 15 critical checks passed: header logo (desktop h=48, mobile h=44, href=/), hero logo (visible on desktop, hidden on mobile per `hidden md:block`), footer logo (h=96), admin login logo, favicon/favicon.ico/crluys-logo.png all return 200. Functional regressions verified: hero CTA opens onboarding modal, 5 hero category pills render, hamburger toggle opens mobile menu, admin login with admin@crluys.com / CrLuys2026! works, /admin dashboard shows Leads/Subscribers/Messages tabs. No visible black rectangle behind logo (uses alpha PNG, drop-shadow only).
critical_code_review_comments: All logo refs centralized to /crluys-logo.png — consider exposing as a single constant (e.g. BRAND_LOGO in lib/api or a brand.js) for easier future swaps; currently the path string is duplicated across Header.jsx, Hero.jsx, Footer.jsx, AdminLogin.jsx.

Hero logo uses `hidden md:block` so it disappears on mobile (verified behaving correctly). If product intends mobile users to also see the logo above the headline, swap to always visible with a smaller mobile size; currently this is the documented intent so no action needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Brand logo regression complete. /crluys-logo.png (214KB transparent PNG) and favicons all serve 200. Header data-testid=header-logo, mobile menu data-testid=mobile-menu / mobile-menu-toggle, admin form data-testid=admin-login-form/admin-email/admin-password/admin-login-submit. Admin dashboard has visible tabs (Leads, Subscribers, Messages) by text. Onboarding modal opens via hero-cta-start.
